subject: Hosted API renewal: capacity ascend and fallback plan
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir@retailnova.com>, Priya Sen <priya@retailnova.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-05-17T09:13:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted API renewal: capacity ascend and fallback plan

Hi Samir / Priya —

Thanks again for a great quarter — really excited by the traction you saw on Recommendations and Chat at the end of Q1. RetailNova's usage growth pattern suggests you'll need a higher monthly commit to avoid soft-throttle during promotional spikes.

Quick proposal (high level):
- Move from current hosted tier (M) to Tier L: +3x monthly commit, lower per-token rate for embeddings and generations.
- Add a soft burst pocket (monthly) to cover marketing promos (one-time overage protection).
- SLA: standard hosted SLOs with a canary fallback to a smaller, higher-latency model variant for low-priority requests.

Attached: draft SOW v3 and your April usage report for reference.

Can we lock the capacity uplift and new rateband for a 12-month renewal? If useful, I can loop in Karthik for a short ops/throughput review call later this week.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Confirm commit size + burst pocket amount (we can share a modeled cost table).
2) Ops review for throttles and rollout window — 48-hour canary then full cutover.
3) Legal/Proc (we'll update SOW) — target effective date 2025-06-01.

Thanks —
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
E: evelyn@redwood.com | M: +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: RetailNova_SOW_v3.pdf (application/pdf), usage_report_Apr2025.csv (text/csv)

From: Samir Shah <samir@retailnova.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Sen <priya@retailnova.com>
Date: 2025-05-17T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API renewal: capacity ascend and fallback plan

Evelyn —

Appreciate the clear proposal. A couple questions before we proceed: 
1) For the soft burst pocket, can you confirm whether burst usage is billed at the lower committed rate or at an overage rate?
2) If we move to Tier L, what are the concrete rate limits per route (qps/token throughput) and do you guarantee any reserved concurrency for critical routes?

Priya and I discussed internally — retailer promotions mean we need both predictable cost and a fast failover if capacity is constrained. The canary fallback sounds good, but we need specifics on latency delta and consistency for recommendation responses.

Can we do a 30-minute ops call tomorrow to go through numbers?

—Samir
Samir Shah | Head of ML Platforms, RetailNova
samir@retailnova.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-05-17T12:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API renewal: capacity ascend and fallback plan (internal ops prep)

Eve / Karthik —

Quick internal notes to prep for the call with RetailNova (tomorrow 10:00 PT if we confirm):
- If we set Tier L commit to 3x their median monthly tokens, we should also recommend enabling prefix KV caching for the recommendations route — estimated 25% cost reduction and 15–30ms median latency improvement.
- Burst pocket: propose a monthly 15% of committed tokens as soft burst at committed rate for first 500M tokens, then overage rate thereafter. We need legal sign-off on the first-tier exception.
- Reserved concurrency: we can reserve 40 concurrent slots on the recommendation cluster for RetailNova during PST daytime (06:00–20:00 PT). Outside that window they stay in the shared pool.
- Canary plan: 48-hour canary routed to 10% of production traffic, measure latency and p95, rollback if error rate > 0.8% or p95 increase > 50ms.

I'll join the call and can bring ops notes; Karthik, can you confirm the concurrency reservation feasibility and any PCI/PII considerations for the recommendation state?

—Kim
Kimberly Park | Solutions & Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-05-17T13:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API renewal: capacity ascend and fallback plan (ops confirmation)

Kim / Eve —

Confirmed on the reserved concurrency window; engineering can implement a weighted routing policy to hold 40 reserved slots for the RetailNova project between 06:00–20:00 PT. A couple implementation notes:
- We will use a soft quota token bucket so reserved slots are not blocking — they'll degrade to best-effort only if overall cluster utilization exceeds 92% for more than 10 minutes.
- Latency delta for the higher-throughput path is expected +20–60ms p95 compared to their existing low-latency bucket; the fallback (smaller model variant) will add +120–200ms but keeps correctness for recommendation API.
- On data residency/compliance: no new concerns — RetailNova already uses hosted with standard retention. If they require additional controls for the canary logs, we'll enable an isolated log stream (additional charge).

I can attend the customer call if you want to walk them through the guardrails.

—Karthik

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir@retailnova.com>, Priya Sen <priya@retailnova.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-05-20T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API renewal: capacity ascend and fallback plan

Samir / Priya —

Thanks for the questions and for the call yesterday. Short answers and confirmation: 
- Burst billing: first 500M tokens of monthly burst are billed at the committed (Tier L) rate as a courtesy protection; any burst beyond that will be billed at the published overage rate in the SOW. We'll call this the "first-tier burst cushion".
- Route limits & concurrency: we'll reserve 40 slots 06:00–20:00 PT as discussed; per-route soft limits will be set to 120 RPS for Recommendations and 60 RPS for Chat generative endpoints at Tier L. Hard throttles only if cluster utilization > 95% sustained.
- Canary: 48 hours at 10% traffic. Thresholds: rollback if error rate > 0.8% or p95 latency delta > 50ms.

If that aligns with you, I'll mark SOW v3 as approved pending signature and have Legal prepare the amendment for a 12-month renewal starting 2025-06-01. Priya — can you confirm budget sign-off this week so we can finalize?

Thanks again — excited to continue scaling with RetailNova.

Evelyn
Evelyn Hart | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
